title: Evidence ledger entry
description: One fetch, recorded immutably. entry_id is the SHA-256 of the canonical URL and is what evidence refs carry as url_hash; content_hash is the SHA-256 of the raw body. Both are hashes rather than URL-derived paths, so a crafted URL can never traverse the filesystem (threat T8). A refusal is a first-class entry with a non-ok outcome and a stated reason, because a blocked path is evidence about the site.

url.description: Canonical dedupe key that was requested.

final_url.description: After redirects; equals url when there were none.

method.description: The method allowlist, visible in the data.

truncated.description: True when the size cap was hit. The render check refuses to judge a page whose body never fully arrived (guard G7).

redirects.description: Every hop, recorded because each one was individually re-validated against the SSRF policy before being followed.

resolved_ip.description: The address that passed validation and was pinned for the connection.

probe_agent.description: For user-agent divergence probes: the crawler token whose treatment was being diagnosed.
